item.title: Brazil’s Petrobras uses Cardano to track sustainable aviation fuel, renewable diesel
item.description: Petrobras developed two Cardano-based applications to track sustainability claims tied to aviation fuel and renewable diesel as part of an ongoing research collaboration.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitget ‘gradually back to usual’ as protection fund reaches $309M
item.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said that a protection fund created by the company in 2022 “absorbed the financial impact of the incident“ that resulted in $388 million in user losses.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Could THORChain face prosecution over stolen Bitget funds?
item.description: THORChain will not — or can not — block addresses linked to the $387.5 million Bitget hack. Can the devs be prosecuted for money laundering? It’s complicated, says crypto lawyer Yuriy Brisov.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Singapore crypto activity grows 55% as broader region contracts
item.description: Singapore’s crypto economy grew 55.4% to $284 billion as institutional-platform activity surged 94%, while the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam stood out for small-value P2P transfers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: FCA opens crypto authorization window ahead of 2027 UK regime
item.description: Crypto businesses should apply by Feb. 28, 2027, while existing money laundering registrations will not convert into FCA authorization.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Altcoin exchange deposit count jumps 160% in 2 weeks
item.description: CryptoQuant flagged potential selling pressure as deposit transactions and depositing addresses hit their highest counts since October 2025.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: A single market worth protecting: Getting the MiCA review right
item.description: As the European Commission’s MiCA review consultation closes, Europe must decide whether its crypto rulebook is protecting the market without making it too costly to build in.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Simon Schneider

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs stretch $3.1B inflow streak as Ether funds turn red
item.description: Ether ETFs shed $3 million Tuesday after seven days of inflows, following an $8 million outflow from Zcash funds at the start of the week.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Crypto hardware wallets compared for 2026
item.description: From touchscreen and QR-code devices to NFC cards and Bitcoin-only models, this guide compares hardware wallets by security, connectivity, usability and recovery options to help users choose the right fit.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph

item.title: SlowMist traces Bitget hack activity to Aug. 31 zero-day exploit
item.description: SlowMist identified malicious activity weeks before the Bitget theft, involving a zero-day vulnerability, two security products and a custom withdrawal tool.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: European stablecoin issuer AllUnity launches USD stablecoin USDAU
item.description: AllUnity is launching USDAU, its fourth fiat-backed stablecoin, expanding a MiCA-regulated lineup that already covers the euro, Swiss franc and Swedish krona.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Kalshi in advanced talks to raise new funding at $40B valuation: Reuters
item.description: The prediction market was valued at $22 billion in a $1 billion funding round just four months ago, after doubling its valuation from December.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Illinois draft crypto tax rules detail DeFi, stablecoin treatment
item.description: Illinois’ draft rules spell out how its 0.2% digital asset transaction tax would apply to stablecoins, DeFi platforms, crypto bridges and self-custody transfers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Crypto.com AI agent still in ‘stealth mode’ nearly 8 months after Super Bowl debut
item.description: In February, ai.com drew enough traffic to crash its website after a $15 million Super Bowl ad, but months later, users are still wondering what’s happened to their promised AI agent.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance Pay lets visitors spend crypto at PayPay merchants in Japan
item.description: Binance Pay will let overseas users spend more than 100 cryptocurrencies at PayPay-supported merchants in Japan through HIVEX, while stores receive yen.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
item.description: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Crypto regulation at SEC, CFTC to come down to 3 commissioners following key resignation
item.description: Seven commissioner seats at the SEC and CFTC will be empty after Friday, leaving only a few leaders at financial regulators to oversee aspects of the $3 trillion crypto industry.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: OpenAI valuation could hit $1.4T in new funding round: Report
item.description: OpenAI is reportedly seeking another $30 billion from investors as the ChatGPT developer pushes its long-awaited public market debut into 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Kakaopay partners with Dinari, Ondo to explore tokenized Korean stocks
item.description: Kakaopay Securities is working with Dinari and Ondo Finance to explore tokenizing Korean-listed equities and expanding their availability to investors in international markets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitwise launches first US spot NEAR ETF after token’s recent surge
item.description: Bitwise’s NEAR ETF begins trading on NYSE Arca as the token rallies more than 160% over the past month and activity on NEAR Intents grows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin gives back gains as long-term holder supply keeps $85K out of reach
item.description: Bitcoin failed to make another run at $85,000 as sellers held the line above current levels, while surging US bond yields weighed on stocks and precious metals.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitget CEO ‘not very optimistic’ on recovering funds from $388M breach
item.description: Gracy Chen said she saw the 2025 Bybit hack as a “good reference point” for Bitget’s security breach, noting that only a small percentage of funds had been frozen or recovered.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Peter Brandt says Bitcoin may hit $600K by 2029, calls XRP a ‘fool coin’
item.description: An October pullback could offer a buying opportunity before Bitcoin’s next cycle peak, which Brandt expects between $300,000 and $600,000. He’s not sold on “fool coin” XRP.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows leave institutional demand unclear: CoinShares
item.description: CoinShares says IBIT offers clues to institutional buying, but basis trades mean inflows are not necessarily bets on rising Bitcoin prices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: ECB puts AI agent payments on the digital euro drawing board
item.description: The ECB is seeking firms to explore AI agents and machine-to-machine interactions as it prepares a separate digital euro pilot for 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia for Oct. 6
item.description: Glamsterdam will bring proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and new gas pricing, while its mainnet date remains unset.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: US crypto ETF inflows cool after $3.3B week but streaks hold
item.description: US spot crypto ETF inflows fell about 80% from Friday as Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and XRP funds attracted $64.8 million combined on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin bounces to $84K after US 30-year bond yield sets 24-year high
item.description: Bitcoin price action consolidated after early-week losses while protecting a “trend-defining” support zone.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Greece gets first MiCA entrants as watchdog denies Binance-Lagarde claim
item.description: Greece joined the EU MiCA register with four providers as HCMC expanded its denial of remarks attributed to officials in a report on Binance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
